reasons.text: The label photo has the same sha256 as another claim in the program (605fbae8-3557-5f4e-9d2e-f9b013a03984), so the claim is flagged for duplicate review under the flag rule.
The label is legible and shows model SE4570, which is a recalled model.
The label date code 07/22 is within the recalled date codes.
The retailer www.grainger.com is on the sold-at list and the purchase date 2022-09-08 is inside the sale window, with no receipt required.
The label serial SN65977978 differs from the typed serial SN84187110, and the serial check was skipped because no serial rule applies here. This is noted for the reviewer.
